reports.title: Ecovyst Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results and Raises 2026 Outlook

lines: “Ecovyst delivered another strong quarter, with third quarter 2026 Adjusted EBITDA of $61 million, up over 6% compared to the year-ago quarter, and above the high end of our guidance range,” said Kurt J.

We are again raising our full-year Adjusted EBITDA guidance to a range of $208 million to $212 million, reflecting strong momentum through the first nine months of the year and the shift of a turnaround from the fourth quarter into early 2027,” Bitting said.
1Sales outlook for 2026 assumes higher average sulfur prices compared to 2025 and higher projected pass-through of sulfur costs of approximately $220 million.
